'import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = [str(column) for column in df.columns]

bucket_field = "Drink Bucket"
metric_field = "Next Day Workout Minutes"
imputed_field = "Next Day Has Imputed Values"
required_fields = [bucket_field, metric_field, imputed_field]
missing_fields = [field for field in required_fields if field not in df.columns]
if missing_fields:
    raise ValueError("Missing fields: " + ", ".join(missing_fields))

df[metric_field] = pd.to_numeric(df[metric_field], errors="coerce")
df[imputed_field] = pd.to_numeric(df[imputed_field], errors="coerce")
df = df[df[bucket_field].notna()].copy()
df = df[df[bucket_field] != "Unknown"].copy()
df = df[df[imputed_field] == 0].copy()
df = df.dropna(subset=[metric_field]).copy()

bucket_order = ["0 drinks", "1 drink", "2 drinks", "3+ drinks"]
df[bucket_field] = pd.Categorical(df[bucket_field], categories=bucket_order, ordered=True)
df = df.dropna(subset=[bucket_field])

bucket_data = [df.loc[df[bucket_field] == bucket, metric_field].values for bucket in bucket_order]
bucket_counts = [len(values) for values in bucket_data]
nonempty = [values for values in bucket_data if len(values) > 0]
if not nonempty:
    raise ValueError("No observed, non-imputed next-day workout records were found.")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15, 5.3))
positions = np.arange(1, len(bucket_order) + 1)
boxplot = ax.boxplot(
    bucket_data,
    positions=positions,
    vert=False,
    patch_artist=True,
    showmeans=True,
    widths=0.58,
    meanprops={"marker": "D", "markerfacecolor": "black", "markeredgecolor": "black", "markersize": 5},
    medianprops={"color": "black", "linewidth": 1.7},
    whiskerprops={"linewidth": 1.1},
    capprops={"linewidth": 1.1},
    flierprops={"marker": "o", "markersize": 3, "alpha": 0},
)

color_map = plt.get_cmap("OrRd")
box_colors = [color_map(0.12), color_map(0.30), color_map(0.50), color_map(0.72)]
for box, color in zip(boxplot["boxes"], box_colors):
    box.set_facecolor(color)
    box.set_alpha(0.72)

random_generator = np.random.default_rng(42)
for position, values, color in zip(positions, bucket_data, box_colors):
    if len(values) == 0:
        continue
    jitter = random_generator.normal(loc=position, scale=0.055, size=len(values))
    ax.scatter(values, jitter, s=18, alpha=0.42, color=color, edgecolors="none")

all_values = np.concatenate(nonempty)
value_range = np.nanmax(all_values) - np.nanmin(all_values)
label_offset = max(value_range * 0.025, 0.25)
for position, values in zip(positions, bucket_data):
    if len(values) == 0:
        continue
    mean_value = np.mean(values)
    ax.text(mean_value + label_offset, position, f"Mean: {mean_value:.0f}", va="center", ha="left", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold")

ax.set_yticks(positions)
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{bucket}  (n={count})" for bucket, count in zip(bucket_order, bucket_counts)], fontsize=10)
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("Next-Day Workout Minutes by Today''''s Drink Count", fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", pad=12)
ax.set_xlabel("Workout minutes on the following day", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("Drink bucket today", fontsize=10)
ax.grid(axis="x", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.35)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
for spine in ["top", "right", "left"]:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0)
current_left, current_right = ax.get_xlim()
ax.set_xlim(current_left, current_right + max(value_range * 0.12, 1))
fig.text(0.5, 0.02, "Distribution of observed, non-imputed next-day workout records.", ha="center", fontsize=9)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.19, right=0.98, top=0.84, bottom=0.18)
plt.show()'
